Frequently Asked User Questions (FAQs)

1. How fast does support respond to bug reports?

Our engineering team typically reviews and addresses technical bug submissions within 24 to 48 business hours.

2. Can I request a new university CGPA calculator or business tool?

Absolutely! Send your university grading formula or custom calculator request to info@toolswaala.in and our team will build and deploy it free of charge.

3. Does ToolsWaala collect personal contact information?

No. ToolsWaala does not require user registration, account signups, phone numbers, or credit card details. All calculation tools function 100% client-side inside your browser.

ToolsWaala Quality Assurance & Feedback Guidelines

We take software accuracy, user data privacy, and web accessibility extremely seriously. ToolsWaala is built following W3C accessibility guidelines, ISO security practices, and modern Core Web Vitals performance benchmarks. Every calculator and generator is audited regularly against revised government tax notifications (CGST/SGST/IGST), Reserve Bank of India (RBI) payment directives, and University Grants Commission (UGC) academic mandates.

Why Indian Students and Businesses Trust ToolsWaala

1. 100% Free Forever: Zero subscription fees, zero premium paywalls, and zero hidden charges.

2. Zero Login Privacy: No account registration required. Your personal data and document inputs remain 100% inside your device's browser memory.

3. Instant Client-Side Speed: Powered by HTML5 WebAssembly and local JavaScript engines for instantaneous calculations without server delays.

Continuous Updates & Platform Maintenance

Our web design system and accessibility tokens are continuously updated to support high-contrast light and dark mode rendering, zero layout shift (CLS), and ultra-fast Interaction to Next Paint (INP) responsiveness across all modern browsers including Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, Microsoft Edge, and Brave.
